verdict.rationale: Testing tooling is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no official end-to-end testing tool and no dev-server testing integration. React Developer Tools, the React Compiler and the ESLint hooks rules cover inspection, optimization and linting, not end-to-end testing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate official end-to-end testing tools that work out of the box with the framework's dev server
